proposed_widenings.name: negate_triggering_spell.refundTargetSlot
proposed_widenings.justification: SRD 5.2.1 explicitly states that when Counterspell succeeds, the target's spell slot is not expended. The current negate_triggering_spell atom has no field for this. A game engine needs this to correctly decide whether to refund the countered caster's slot resource.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn't expended.

notes: Core structure encodes cleanly: triggered_reaction family, creature_casts_spell trigger (V/S/M), Con save_gate, negate_triggering_spell on fail, autoSuccessIfCasterSlotGte for the upcast auto-success path. The single gap is the slot-refund clause — negate_triggering_spell needs an optional refundTargetSlot: true field to express that the countered caster recovers the expended slot on a successful counterspell.
